data.one_liner: A flutter_map plugin for displaying custom widgets on specific geographic areas of the map.
data.what_it_does: It allows developers to place any custom Flutter widget onto a flutter_map instance by specifying geographic coordinates, dimensions in meters, or corner points. Widgets can be constrained, made clickable, and configured to rotate or maintain fixed orientations.
use_when: You need to render custom Flutter widgets overlaid on specific geographic locations inside a flutter_map.
You want widgets to scale and optionally rotate based on map zoom levels and orientation settings.
avoid_when: You are using Google Maps instead of flutter_map.
You only need standard map markers and pins rather than complex layout widgets.
strengths: Enables placement of arbitrary widgets on maps using geographic bounds or center points.
Supports size constraints and orientation forcing (portrait or landscape).
Widgets can be interactive and clickable.
weaknesses: Performance may depend on the complexity and number of rendered widget overlays.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency and integrating `PolyWidgetLayer` into your `FlutterMap` widget tree.
